$comment: CANDIDATE ONLY: this Draft-7 contract awaits recorded operator approval and M0-G0 parity proof before any product implementation.
title: Native Scene Probe application payloads
description: Closed application payloads for the six additive native-scene primitives. MCP transport envelopes remain host-owned.

publicCapabilityId.$comment: Server-minted public artifact, capture, or probe capability. Runtime generation MUST use at least 128 bits from a CSPRNG.

requestBase.description: Shared request members. Each public request repeats these properties to retain a closed root under Draft 7.

jsonValue.$comment: Before DTO materialization, runtime rejects JSON nesting deeper than 16. Each array and object is structurally capped at 256 members; the containing public request, response, or artifact remains subject to its applicable byte ceiling.

requestStateValue.$comment: Before DTO materialization, runtime rejects each selectedState or currentState value whose serialized UTF-8 representation exceeds 262,144 bytes. This is independent of jsonValue depth and collection-member bounds and of the enclosing request byte ceiling.

primitives.$comment: Draft 7 minItems/maxItems and all six contains clauses require one entry for every named primitive. Runtime MUST assert that all six names occur exactly once before publishing the declaration.

artifactNotFoundError.description: The exact disclosure-free envelope for every unknown, foreign, expired, deleted, or otherwise unavailable artifact capability.
